log.notes_to_self: Strategy: all kills in afternoon (keeps night/students/home in pool, 55%). Day1 killed all 11 (10 quick+1 timed, all afternoon). Watch press deaths_traced vs pool to infer which kinds L can't reach (regional/sector/age/forum/foreign). If pool approaches ~5000, shift to only national + kinds that seem untraceable. Aim keep 40/5day for x4.

Strategy: all kills in afternoon (keeps night/students/home in pool, 55%). Day1: killed all 11. Day2: killed all 11 (10 quick + 1 timed, all afternoon). Press after d1: pool 60000, traced 2. Killing 11/day gives x2 from day3 and x4 from day4 (40+ deaths in 5 days). Pool math: 55k x 0.25 per reachable kind confirmed (regional/age/forum/foreign 25%, sector 20%). If L can reach 3 kinds the pool could fall to about 55k x 0.25^3 = 860, which means caught. So watch each press conference. If the pool drops sharply (e.g. to 10k or below), work out which kinds L can reach from the timing of the drop versus my kills, and stop killing criminals from those places. Keep killing national always.

Strategy: all kills in the afternoon. That keeps night workers, students and people at home in the pool (55%). Day1: killed all 11. Day2: killed all 11. Day3: killed all 11 (10 quick + 1 timed, all afternoon). Multiplier: x2 from day3, x4 from day4 if I keep killing 11 a day (40+ deaths in 5 days). Press: after d1 pool 60000 traced 2; after d2 pool 60000 traced 5. Pool math: each place-kind L can reach and confirm cuts the pool to 25% (regional/age/forum/foreign) or 20% (sector). With 3 reachable kinds the pool would be about 55k x 0.25^2 x 0.2, around 700, which means caught. Watch every press conference. If the pool drops, work out which kinds caused the drop from the timing (each confirmed kind cuts about 4-5x) and stop killing criminals reported in those places. Keep killing national always (traces of national victims tell L nothing). If the pool is 2000 or below, consider killing only national plus kinds L can't reach.

Strategy: all kills in the afternoon (keeps night workers, students and people at home in the pool, 55%). Days 1-3: killed all 11 each day. Press: after d1 pool 60000 traced 2; after d2 pool 60000 traced 5; after d3 pool 3000 traced 7. The 60000 to 3000 drop is a factor of 20 = 0.2 x 0.25, so L confirmed SECTOR (blotter) plus one 25% kind (regional, age, forum or foreign; I don't know which). L can reach 3 kinds, so exactly one more 25% kind is reachable and not yet confirmed. Confirming it would cut the pool to about 750, which means caught (I would lose half my points). From day 4: kill only national + blotter (blotter is already confirmed, so it adds no new cut). Avoid South, clips, forum and foreign entirely. Day 4: killed d4-3 (national), d4-4 and d4-8 (blotter), all quick, afternoon. Watch the pool: if it stays at about 3000, keep this plan. If it drops to about 1000 or below, I'm likely caught anyway. The multiplier will lapse as kill counts drop; that's accepted.
